card.name: Linking words in NSAID lists
card.fires_on: Commas and linking words such as "to", "as" and "including" right after an NSAID name or the class term NSAIDs, where another NSAID is about to be named.

modes.label: Comma in drug list
modes.description: A comma after one NSAID name in a list of examples.

modes.label: Linking word after NSAIDs
modes.description: Words like "such as" or "including" after NSAIDs or a sensitivity phrase, leading into drug names.
modes.example: may be attenuated by NSAIDs<< including>> selective COX-2 inhibitors.

card.plain: It fires on the comma or small linking word just before the next NSAID is named in a list.
